title: HDL Protocol for Sample Analysis
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ynsfvee

steps.title: Precipitate Sample
steps.instruction: Combine sample and precipitation buffer to isolate the HDL fraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 25µl 2X precipitation buffer to 25µl of sample using a positive displacement pipet.
Let sit at room temperature (RT) for 10 minutes.
Pipet the supernatant into a new tube; this is the HDL fraction.

steps.title: Prepare Assay Plate
steps.instruction: Dispense calibrator and samples into the plate wells, ensuring no bubbles are present.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µl of calibrator and sample to each well.

steps.title: Perform TC or TG Assay
steps.instruction: React the samples with TC or TG reagent and measure absorbance.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µl of TC or TG reagent to each well.
If samples are hemolyzed, pipet a blank well with 5µl sample and 300µl PBS.

steps.title: Calculate HDL and LDL/VLDL Values
steps.instruction: Process the absorbance readings to determine final concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings.
Calculate unknown samples using the formula: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration.
Multiply the result by 2 to account for the 1/2 dilution of HDL samples.
Subtract this final HDL value from the total triglyceride or cholesterol value to determine the LDL/VLDL value.
